argv:
set -euo pipefail
ulimit -c 0
unset VITE_MODEL_CATALOG_URL GINFER_MODEL_CATALOG_URL IS_DEV NODE_OPTIONS NODE_ENV FORCE_ONBOARDING FRESH_INSTALL FORCE_HARDWARE_TIER TAURI_CONFIG TAURI_DEV_HOST TAURI_ENV_DEBUG IS_IOS IS_ANDROID IS_CLEAN CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS CARGO_BUILD_TARGET RUSTFLAGS GINFER_PROFILE_CATALOGS CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
stage() {
  name="$1"; shift
  date -u +%FT%TZ > "/work/$name.start"
  if "$@" > "/work/$name.log" 2>&1; then code=0; else code=$?; fi
  date -u +%FT%TZ > "/work/$name.end"
  printf '%s\n' "$code" > "/work/$name.exit"
  printf '%s exit=%s\n' "$name" "$code"
  return "$code"
}

cp /work/candidate/web-app/src/routes/hub/__tests__/index.test.tsx web-app/src/routes/hub/__tests__/index.test.tsx
stage core-assets yarn build:core
if stage baseline-focused yarn workspace @gchat/web-app exec vitest run src/routes/hub/__tests__/index.test.tsx --maxWorkers=8 -t 'says it is checking|keeps the first failed'; then
  exit 90
else
  code=$?
  test "$code" -eq 1
  python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; s=Path("/work/baseline-focused.log").read_text(); assert "2 failed" in s, s[-2000:]; assert "of unfinished downloads" in s; print("BASELINE_EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR_FAILURES")'
fi
cp /work/candidate/web-app/src/containers/ModelManagement.tsx web-app/src/containers/ModelManagement.tsx
stage candidate-focused yarn workspace @gchat/web-app exec vitest run src/routes/hub/__tests__/index.test.tsx src/stores/local-model-downloads-store.test.ts --maxWorkers=8
stage affected-lint yarn workspace @gchat/web-app exec eslint src/containers/ModelManagement.tsx src/routes/hub/__tests__/index.test.tsx
stage extensions-assets bash --noprofile --norc -c 'cd extensions && yarn workspaces foreach -Apt run build:publish'
stage tauri-assets yarn copy:assets:tauri
stage frontend-build yarn build:web
stage native-host cargo build --locked --offline --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -p ginfer-host --bin ginfer-host
stage native-app cargo build --locked --offline --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -p gchat --bin gchat
guards: SH /tmp/ginfer-s1-socket1-compile.lock only; pinned socket1 compile rule
frontend: normal production Vite build; dev/catalog overrides unset
tests: baseline two behavior regressions once; candidate hub/store focused + affected lint; native build then ONE make verify
